findings.issue: Absolute GNU linker LOAD aliases can include parent components
findings.resolution: Preserve lexical row, check normpath and realpath virtual roots, capture canonical regular file and recheck alias; no missing-row skip or all-input-authentication claim
Header staticassert upper LONG_MAX and explicit number cast; long-sized variadic operands; no guessed syscall value
Explicit narrow fdinfo/currentPID/poll/close/EBADF scope; no inode/flag identity claim

findings.issue: Declared inputs could drift between initial checks and product launch
findings.resolution: Production callback rechecks original inputs/self/marker before compile and immediately before runtime; final postvalidation still needed; trusted filesystem baseline no atomic-execution authentication
